review.rationale: The Decision correctly preserves the v0.1 review failure and explicitly forbids retrying the same recommendation. It freezes the five-path patch (sha256 bound, no changes authorized) and gates commit/push strictly on all three validation stages passing sequentially. The remediation is tightly scoped to one untracked temporary validator whose sole semantic change is full-name Git path listing joined to the Git top-level, preserving duplicate-rejecting content semantics. All non-authorizations are complete and authority boundaries are preserved. The recommendation chain from v0.2 is valid and remotely verified. The validation failure classification (CWD relative path issue) is sound and the remediation directly addresses it.
